The '''Kalindan Defense System''' was a series of centrally controlled, unmanned defense network of planetary [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] and [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Ion mine/Legends|ion mines]]. The system was controlled from a central base, and required a [[modular command circuit]] to function. The system was under the command of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] until the [[Kalindan]]s [[Kalindan revolt|revolted]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The [[Technician/Legends|technician]] in charge disabled the system and took the command module with him. Fortunately for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the technician was picked up by a New Republic [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] disguised as an Imperial frigate and he surrendered it into their custody. Around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the New Republic arranged for the return of the command circuit in exchange for notes on [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] countermeasures that the [[Kalindan Royal Research Facility]] was developing.
